error.mismatch:
The AI returned a different number of translations than requested.
This usually means the model lost track of a long batch. Please try again, or pick a different model in Settings.
error.invalidFormat:
The AI returned an unexpected response format.
Please try again, or pick a different model in Settings.

history.title: Translation History
history.confirmClear: Are you sure you want to clear all translation history?
error.unknown: An unknown error occurred. Please try again.
error.429.gemini:
Gemini API daily free quota limit reached (429).
Open Settings (⚙️) and switch the provider to the keyless 'Free Google Translate' to continue, or raise your quota on Google AI Studio.
error.429.generic:
{engine} API rate limit reached (429).
Please wait and try again, or open Settings (⚙️) and switch to 'Free Google Translate' to continue.
error.403:
API key invalid or not activated (403).
Open Settings (⚙️) to check your key is entered correctly, and ensure the corresponding APIs are enabled in your Google Cloud Console.
error.400:
Invalid file structure or API parameter error (400).
This usually happens due to incompatible custom document styles. Try switching to 'Free Google Translate' to bypass formatting limits.
error.timeout:
API request timed out.
Please check your internet connection, or try again later when the network is stable.
error.interrupted:
Translation was interrupted by a browser or extension restart.
Please click the "Translate & Copy" button at the top to retry.
error.stopped:
Translation stopped by user.
If you need to translate again, please click the "Translate & Copy" button.
alert.commFailed: Communication with background worker failed. Please try again.
alert.notConnected: Not connected to background service. Attempting to reconnect...
